skills.title: Brainstorm options
skills.description: Generate genuinely different options, compare them honestly, and choose the strongest ones.

skills.title: Pressure-test an idea
skills.description: Find the weak points in an idea before committing to it. Test assumptions, objections, and likely failure modes.

skills.title: Make a decision
skills.description: Match the amount of analysis to the stakes, compare the real options, and record what would change the decision.

skills.title: Solve a problem
skills.description: Take a messy problem from diagnosis through research, options, recommendation, and implementation.

skills.title: Shape and draft a document
skills.description: Work out what an important document needs to achieve before drafting it. Use research and several rounds of focused questions.

skills.title: Gather context
skills.description: Search the sources that are likely to matter and turn the findings into one concise, well-sourced brief.

skills.title: Learn with a tutor
skills.description: Learn a topic through short explanations, active recall, and questions that adjust to your understanding.

skills.title: Write in my voice
skills.description: Use a personal style guide to draft messages that sound like the user instead of generic AI writing.

skills.title: Write a professional social post
skills.description: Turn notes or source material into a clear social post with a strong opening and a specific point.

skills.title: Write a case study post
skills.description: Turn a person's real change into a short, evidence-based case study without exaggerating their story.

skills.title: Plan your day
skills.description: Choose one most important outcome, protect time for it, and make a realistic plan around existing commitments.

skills.title: Review your day
skills.description: Run a short end-of-day reflection on what happened, what mattered, and what should change tomorrow.

skills.title: Plan your week
skills.description: Review the previous week, choose a few outcomes, cut lower-value work, and protect time for what matters.

skills.title: Review and plan a month
skills.description: Close one month honestly, choose a theme for the next, and turn it into a small set of concrete commitments.

skills.title: Get unstuck
skills.description: Work out why you are stuck, then use a short intervention suited to tiredness, dread, confusion, or distraction.

skills.title: Wind down for sleep
skills.description: Guide a short evening routine that closes open loops, prepares the environment, and makes sleep easier.

skills.title: Prepare for a meeting
skills.description: Gather the relevant history, clarify the desired outcome, and produce a focused agenda and preparation brief.

skills.title: Capture meeting actions
skills.description: Review meeting notes, identify genuine commitments, create clear tasks, and ask about uncertain cases.

skills.title: Turn a message into a task
skills.description: Read the full conversation, work out the real action, do useful preparation, and create a clear task only when needed.

skills.title: Design a work sample
skills.description: Create a short paid exercise that tests the real work of a role and distinguishes strong from weak performance.

skills.title: Run a reference call
skills.description: Prepare and run a concise reference conversation that gathers specific evidence instead of vague praise.

skills.title: Process hiring referrals
skills.description: Turn referral messages into structured candidate leads, preserve context, and close the loop with the hiring owner.

skills.title: Turn email into recruiting leads
skills.description: Extract possible candidates from email, check for duplicates, and add useful records to a recruiting system.

skills.title: Write a participant reference
skills.description: Build a careful reference from application evidence, participation, feedback, and the person's own work.

skills.title: Use a browser safely
skills.description: Control websites carefully, inspect before acting, verify every change, and separate preparation from final submission.

skills.title: Create an AI skill
skills.description: Turn a repeated workflow into a focused skill, test when it triggers, and improve it using real examples.

skills.title: Test every screen size
skills.description: Check a user interface across narrow, wide, short, and tall screens using screenshots and numerical checks.

skills.title: Review business expenses
skills.description: Find missing receipts, unclear notes, ageing transactions, and policy risks, then prepare fixes for approval.

skills.title: Run a recurring community event
skills.description: Create a repeatable weekly event, prepare its materials, invite the right people, and verify every public detail.
